These fixtures come from `.wavemill/incidents/2026-10-27-operator-audit/evidence.json` (captured incident records and their retained evidence), converted with `incidentToFixture` and sanitized by the production converter. The original snapshot's `escalatedAt` can predate the retained evidence; fixtures with fewer than three observations therefore expect `observed` during replay rather than claiming that the replay observed the missing escalation history.

`shared/lib/root-cause-escalation.test.ts` loads each fixture through the schema-validated loader, replays the real incident cycle/recovery policy, and verifies append-once transport to HOK-3312 (cleanup), HOK-3315 (install health), or HOK-3255 (eval). The registered `defect-escalation` golden journey additionally crosses the real monitor's tracked-job dispatcher, real headless CLI contract through shared fakes, persisted investigation artifact and Linear transport boundaries.
